coalesceIfActive.title: Coalesce if active
coalesceIfActive.desc: Keep one follow-up run queued while an active run is still working.

alwaysEnqueue.title: Always enqueue
alwaysEnqueue.desc: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if several runs stack up.

skipIfActive.title: Skip if active
skipIfActive.desc: Drop overlapping trigger occurrences while the routine is already active.

skipMissed.title: Skip missed
skipMissed.desc: Ignore schedule windows that were missed while paused.

enqueueMissedWithCap.title: Enqueue missed with cap
enqueueMissedWithCap.desc: Catch up missed schedule windows after recovery; sub-hourly schedules are combined into one catch-up run, slower schedules replay each missed window up to a cap.

alwaysTick.title: Run on every scheduled tick
alwaysTick.desc: Fire on the schedule no matter what — the default behavior.

skipNoActivity.title: Skip when there's been no activity since the last run
skipNoActivity.desc: On a scheduled tick, only run if something happened since the last run that finished. Lets a watcher-style routine stay asleep while the system is settled instead of burning tokens.

orgWide.title: Organization-wide
orgWide.desc: Any activity across the organization counts as a reason to run.

companyWide.title: Company-wide
companyWide.desc: Any activity across the company counts as a reason to run.

project.title: This project
project.desc: Only activity in the routine's project counts as a reason to run.

signing.bearer: Send Authorization: Bearer <secret> with each request.
signing.hmacSha256: Send X-Paperclip-Timestamp and X-Paperclip-Signature: sha256=<hex>, signing timestamp + a dot + the exact JSON body.
signing.githubHmac: Accept GitHub-style X-Hub-Signature-256 header (HMAC over raw body, no timestamp).
signing.appWebhook: Accept a bearer token or an HMAC-SHA256 signature over the exact request body in X-Hub-Signature or X-Hub-Signature-256.
signing.none: No authentication — the webhook URL itself acts as a shared secret.
